meta.topic: What to Say During a Traffic Stop to Protect Your Rights

elements.content: Know exactly what to say when pulled over

style_notes: Dark moody background, red accent (#E94560), clean bold typography. The '4 LINES' is the dominant visual element — large, red, impossible to miss. Subtext clarifies the value proposition.
hook_source: Four specific lines that constitutional lawyers have refined over decades of litigation — memorize these and you protect your rights in every traffic stop
revised_hook: Four specific lines that constitutional lawyers have refined over decades of litigation. Say these, and you protect your rights. Forget one, and you could lose everything.
